_doc: Grand Hotel restaurant, hands-on (gameplay plan: serve the tables, room service, events). During the services guests sit at the tables; E on a table takes the order, the kitchen cooks for cook_minutes, E at the kitchen pass picks up what is ready, E on the table serves it (price + tip for speed). Suites order room service, delivered with E at the lift. Whatever waits longer than crew_minutes is served by the hotel crew at crew_share. Events are booked a day ahead and happen at event_hour. World cm: tables = table centres, pass and room_service = E targets [x, y, z, yaw].
